options.description: The shape of the answer. A slot character takes input and any other is drawn as it is.
options.name: template

options.description: Asks with plain lines in and lines out rather than a region that redraws, for a screen reader: the question is written once, what is typed is echoed where it is typed, and nothing already written is ever moved or erased.
options.name: accessible

options.description: Whether Escape leaves the prompt to go back a step. Defaults to `false`, where Escape does nothing, as it always has.
options.name: back

options.description: Answered when nothing has been typed. A string is read the way a paste is, so `'5551234567'` and `'(555) 123-4567'` are the same default; it has to fill every slot, and the answer is the formatted text either way. Shown dimmed in the empty field in place of the blank template, unless `placeholder` says otherwise.
options.name: default

options.description: What the field starts with, editable. Read the way a paste is, and refused if any of it does not fit the template. It may leave slots empty; unlike `default` it is not a fallback.
options.name: initial

options.description: Shown dimmed while nothing has been typed, in place of the blank template.
options.name: placeholder

options.description: The input router to read keys through. One is built if not given.
options.name: router

options.description: Gives the prompt up when this aborts, the way Ctrl-C does.
options.name: signal

options.description: Slots of your own, by the character that stands for them in `template`, each a single character. They are added to `MASK_SLOTS`, and replace one of those where they share a character.
options.name: slots

options.description: Where keys come from. Defaults to the terminal's input.
options.name: stdin

options.description: Checks the answer, once every slot is filled. Receives the formatted text. Return a string to reject it with that message, or anything falsy to accept.
options.name: validate
options.type: (value: string) => string | undefined | false | Promise<string | undefined | false>

options.description: An answer to start from: the field opens holding it, read the way `initial` is, which it beats. One that does not fit the template -- an answer to a template that has since changed -- is dropped rather than refused, leaving `initial`.
options.name: value

registryDescription: A masked text prompt: a line that follows a template, with fixed characters skipped
